source_identity.scope: On-disk module files read when this report is captured, not loaded-bytecode attestation. External run records bind execution to source.

qualification: Trusted synchronous CPU work, not a real-time deadline guarantee

clock.session_units: seconds elapsed on injected monotonic clock
clock.physical_units: process time.monotonic seconds, separate clock domain
clock.deadline: Physical submission only, expires at or after deadline. Accepted queued work may start later and complete normally.

timeout_policy: finish(timeout) is a soft owner observation budget. Retirement then waits for trusted synchronous work and cleanup, without a total shutdown deadline.

metric_definitions.physical_values: Analysis loop visits, including partial canceled work. Excludes validation, input digests and receipt overhead.
metric_definitions.usable: Executor-usable completions at reconciliation. Numeric adoption additionally requires a Summary and a current revision.
metric_definitions.stale: Physical outcomes reconciled under a newer data revision, including cancellations and failures.
